name: Tyre
description: A thick ring with a tread of radial notches cut into its outer half.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--color1); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 24%, #000 24% 38%, transparent 38%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 24%, #000 24% 38%, transparent 38%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 38%, #000 38% 50%, transparent 50%), repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, #000 0 8%, transparent 8% 16%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 38%, #000 38% 50%, transparent 50%), repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, #000 0 8%, transparent 8% 16%); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
